coverage_gaps: Only PubMed is available for bibliographic retrieval; Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, CINAHL, and other subject indexes are unavailable, limiting conference, citation-index, and non-MEDLINE coverage.
No citation-graph or DOI metadata route is available for systematic forward and backward citation traversal or independent correction-link verification.
Regulatory routing is limited to FDA; EMA, MHRA, Health Canada, PMDA, and other jurisdictional assessments and labels cannot be searched directly.

No dedicated Retraction Watch, Crossmark, publisher-platform, or Crossref route is available, so integrity status relies on PubMed-linked publication types and notices discoverable through the available routes.
Preprint servers and grey-literature repositories are unavailable; recent unreviewed or unpublished qualifying analyses may be missed.
ClinicalTrials.gov is the sole available registry route; non-US or separately registered companion studies may be missed.
exclusion_criteria: Records first published or regulatory actions first effective after 2024-12-31, while later metadata that merely indexes an eligible earlier event is flagged rather than used as new evidence.
Nonhuman, in vitro, pharmacokinetic-only, or mechanistic studies lacking direct relevance to the specified clinical safety outcomes.

Studies confined to non-rheumatoid-arthritis populations unless they directly explain an FDA class-wide action or materially contextualize a tofacitinib regulatory decision; such contextual evidence cannot replace RA evidence.
Efficacy-only reports without cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, mortality, or safety-action information.
Narrative summaries, news reports, promotional materials, and unsourced secondary webpages when a registry, primary publication, FDA record, or peer-reviewed analysis is available.
Duplicate bibliographic records are merged at the canonical-record layer while all source and query hit links remain retained.
Abstract-only reports with insufficient methods or outcome detail for assessment when a complete report is available.
inclusion_criteria: Records published, posted, corrected, or regulator-effective on or before 2024-12-31, with online-first, issue, registry-update, correction, and FDA action dates captured separately.
The NCT02092467 registry record, its history and results fields, linked publications, and records explicitly sharing ORAL Surveillance or A3921133 identity.
The primary ORAL Surveillance publication and peer-reviewed secondary analyses reporting cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, mortality, dose, or subgroup findings.
FDA safety communications, prescribing-information revisions, boxed warnings, and other FDA actions that explicitly concern tofacitinib or use the pivotal trial as evidence.
Human rheumatoid arthritis comparative studies, systematic reviews, or meta-analyses that can qualify, reproduce, or conflict with the pivotal findings and report interpretable methods and outcomes.
Correction, erratum, retraction, expression-of-concern, or linked-comment records associated with included primary evidence.
Evidence must permit provenance to a PMID, DOI, NCT identifier, FDA document or label version, and preserve every query-to-record occurrence even when canonical records are deduplicated.

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal postauthorization registry record and verify official title, sponsor study number, design, doses, comparators, outcomes, enrollment, dates, and linked publications.
Recover the primary publication and the study-family records using registry and study identifiers.
queries.query: ("NCT02092467"[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR "A3921133"[All Fields]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Locate FDA materials that explicitly connect the required safety trial to regulatory review or action.
Confirm the primary publication identity, bibliographic metadata, abstract, publication type, and links to comments or corrections.
queries.query: "Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[Title] OR "10.1056/NEJMoa2109927"[All Fields] OR "35081280"[PMID]

queries.purpose: Check for duplicate, predecessor, extension, or related registry records and reconcile identifiers with NCT02092467.
queries.query: AREA[ConditionSearch] "Rheumatoid Arthritis" AND (AREA[InterventionSearch] tofacitinib OR AREA[OtherTerms] A3921133)

queries.purpose: Retrieve broad peer-reviewed RA safety evidence without an aggressive exclusion clause.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[MeSH Terms] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR "adverse events"[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thromb*[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve primary and secondary study-family analyses covering every prespecified safety domain.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[All Fields]) AND ("major adverse cardiovascular event*"[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR "venous thromboembolism"[Title/Abstract] OR thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Recover the FDA communication announcing trial-based cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality conclusions and prescribing restrictions.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz safety trial serious heart-related events cancer blood clots death September 2021 Drug Safety Communication

queries.purpose: Recover dated label revisions and verify the exact boxed-warning language, affected indications, doses, and effective dates.
queries.query: Xeljanz tofacitinib prescribing information boxed warning major adverse cardiovascular events malignancy thrombosis mortality 2021 2022

queries.purpose: Trace the earlier dose-related pulmonary embolism and mortality signal and the sequence of FDA interim actions preceding final trial publication.
queries.query: tofacitinib 10 mg twice daily pulmonary embolism mortality rheumatoid arthritis safety trial 2019 FDA

queries.purpose: Find external observational and synthesized evidence that may qualify, reproduce, or conflict with ORAL Surveillance.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[MeSH Terms]) AND ("TNF inhibitor"[Title/Abstract] OR adalimumab[Title/Abstract] OR etanercept[Title/Abstract]) AND (cohort[Title/Abstract] OR observational[Title/Abstract] OR "real-world"[Title/Abstract] OR STAR-RA[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type])

queries.purpose: Retrieve analyses of effect modification and identify populations in whom absolute or relative risk differs.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[All Fields]) AND (subgroup*[Title/Abstract] OR stratified[Title/Abstract] OR smoking[Title/Abstract] OR smoker*[Title/Abstract] OR "65 years"[Title/Abstract] OR "cardiovascular risk"[Title/Abstract] OR "history of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Detect corrections, errata, retractions, or expressions of concern affecting anchor records or downstream evidence handling.
queries.query: (("Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[All Fields] OR NCT02092467[All Fields]) AND (Correction[Publication Type] OR Retracted Publication[Publication Type] OR Retraction of Publication[Publication Type] OR correction[Title] OR erratum[Title] OR retraction[Title] OR "expression of concern"[Title]))

queries.purpose: Actively seek null, negative, inconsistent, or failed-replication evidence that could challenge a one-directional safety interpretation.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("no increased risk"[Title/Abstract] OR null[Title/Abstract] OR conflicting[Title/Abstract] OR inconsistent[Title/Abstract] OR replication[Title/Abstract] OR "risk not increased"[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR thromb*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Capture post-primary-publication analyses and integrity updates through the as-of cutoff, with online-first and issue dates reconciled during screening.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thromb*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR correction[Title] OR retraction[Title])) AND ("2022/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Check for subsequent FDA communications, labeling changes, or status updates through 2024-12-31.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz rheumatoid arthritis safety label Drug Safety Communication 2022 2023 2024 cardiovascular cancer thrombosis mortality

question_frame: Safety PECO: among patients with rheumatoid arthritis, with particular attention to the ORAL Surveillance population aged 50 years or older with at least one cardiovascular risk factor, assess marketed tofacitinib at approved and studied doses versus tumor necrosis factor inhibitors and relevant external comparators through 2024-12-31 for major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy, venous and arterial thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and all-cause or cardiovascular mortality. Link the postauthorization study registry, protocol identifiers, primary publication, subsequent analyses, and FDA communications or labeling actions; characterize effect estimates, dose and subgroup modifiers, qualifying or conflicting evidence, and correction, expression-of-concern, or retraction status.
stop_rules: Complete all planned sentinel, discovery, confirmation, expansion, challenge, and update events across pubmed, clinicaltrials_gov, and fda_regulatory without exceeding 16 query events.

Confirm recovery and identity linkage of NCT02092467, A3921133 or ORAL Surveillance, the primary publication identified by PMID 35081280 or DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa2109927, and the corresponding FDA safety communications and label actions.

Continue terminology expansion until the anchor registry, publication, FDA action, and at least one eligible evidence item for each of cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality are recovered or the missing domain is documented as a gap.

Stop citation or study-family expansion after two consecutive completed expansion or challenge events add no new decision-relevant canonical record, effect estimate, regulatory action, or evidence-integrity notice.
Complete explicit correction, erratum, retraction, expression-of-concern, null-result, and conflicting-evidence checks before synthesis can begin.

Reconcile registry IDs, PMID, DOI, FDA document dates, drug doses, comparators, outcome definitions, follow-up, effect measures, confidence intervals, and subgroup definitions for every decision-critical claim.

Apply the 2024-12-31 cutoff after retrieval when provider date syntax is ambiguous and stop only after online-first, issue, registry-update, correction, and FDA effective dates have been distinguished.
If the 16-event budget is exhausted before these conditions are met, stop deterministically and report the unresolved domains, unsearched aliases, and unavailable source classes in coverage_gaps.
